@da-facility.sidebarLayout.navigation.description: Default accessible name for the navigation, and its title in the sidebar.

@da-facility.mobileNavigation.open.description: Floating menu button on phones. {label} is the navigation name in lowercase.

@da-facility.mobileNavigation.close.description: Button that closes the navigation drawer on phones.

@da-facility.mobileNavigation.leftHanded.description: Switch that moves the menu button and drawer to the left edge.

@da-facility.userMenu.label.description: Accessible name of the account button. {name} is the person’s name.

@da-facility.projectSelector.label.description: Default heading of the project menu and its accessible name.

@da-facility.projectSelector.trigger.description: Accessible name of the project button, such as “Projects: Web app”.

@da-facility.projectSelector.noneSelecte.description: Shown on the project button when no project is selected.

@da-facility.projectSelector.searchLabel.description: Accessible name of the search field. {label} is the menu heading in lowercase.

@da-facility.projectSelector.searchPlace.description: Placeholder of the compact search field.

@da-facility.projectSelector.clearSearch.description: Button that empties the search field.

@da-facility.projectSelector.noMatches.description: Shown when the search finds nothing.

@da-facility.projectSelector.create.description: Action at the end of the project menu.

@da-facility.loginSplit.title.description: Default heading of the sign-in form.

@da-facility.loginSplit.error.defaultMessage: Unable to sign in. Please try again.
@da-facility.loginSplit.error.description: Shown when sign-in fails without a message of its own.

@da-facility.loginPocketId.label.description: Accessible name of the Pocket ID sign-in page when it has no title.

@da-facility.pocketIdButton.label.description: Button that starts signing in with Pocket ID, an identity provider. Keep “Pocket ID” untranslated.

@da-facility.assistant.label.description: Label of the chat bar and title of the open chat.

@da-facility.assistant.placeholder.defaultMessage: What can I do for you today?

@da-facility.assistant.suggestions.description: Accessible name of the list of starter prompts.

@da-facility.assistant.context.description: Accessible name of the tag showing what the assistant can see.

@da-facility.cycleButton.label.description: Accessible name of a button that steps through states, such as “Theme: Dark”.

@da-facility.toast.notifications.description: Accessible name of the region the toasts appear in.

@da-facility.toast.close.description: Accessible name of a toast's close button.

@da-facility.codeInput.label.description: Accessible name of the boxes for a sign-in code sent by email or text message.

@da-facility.loginEmailCode.title.description: Heading of the first sign-in step, where the person enters their email address.

@da-facility.loginEmailCode.description.defaultMessage: Enter your email address. We’ll send you a one-time code.
@da-facility.loginEmailCode.description.description: Text under the first step’s heading.

@da-facility.loginEmailCode.sendCode.description: Button that sends a one-time code to the email address.

@da-facility.loginEmailCode.codeTitle.description: Heading of the second step, where the person types the code from the email.

@da-facility.loginEmailCode.codeDescript.description: Text under the second step’s heading. {email} is the address the code went to.

@da-facility.loginEmailCode.resend.description: Link under the code boxes that sends another code.

@da-facility.loginEmailCode.resendIn.defaultMessage: Send a new code in {seconds} s
@da-facility.loginEmailCode.resendIn.description: The resend link while it waits. {seconds} counts down.

@da-facility.loginEmailCode.resent.description: Confirmation after a new code was sent.

@da-facility.loginEmailCode.changeEmail.description: Link back to the email step.

@da-facility.loginEmailCode.invalidCode.defaultMessage: That code isn’t right. Check your email or request a new code.
@da-facility.loginEmailCode.invalidCode.description: Shown when the code is wrong.

@da-facility.loginEmailCode.expiredCode.defaultMessage: That code has expired. Request a new code.
@da-facility.loginEmailCode.expiredCode.description: Shown when the code is too old.

@da-facility.loginEmailCode.tooManyAttem.defaultMessage: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes} min.
@da-facility.loginEmailCode.tooManyAttem.description: Shown while sign-in is locked. {minutes} is how long to wait.

@da-facility.loginEmailCode.error.description: Shown when sending or checking a code fails without a message of its own.
